name: DashboardSecurity
title: Blocks/Dashboard/DashboardSecurity
summary: The security dashboard pattern: blocked and allowed requests over time, breakdowns by attack category and origin, the top sources and an attention list, under a PageHeader whose Period Select sets the comparison of every delta and the period in each exported CSV name. A row of three StatTiles (Requests blocked, Requests inspected, Block rate, each with its delta against the previous period and a sparkline) sits over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. Matched requests over time plots blocked and logged requests; Needs attention lists the settings and traffic that ask for a decision, each with a severity Tag and one action Link; attack categories and countries read as ranked BarLists, and the top source IPs as a searchable, paginated DataTable. With no rule set in place the tiles stay as dashes and one setup EmptyState that offers Add rule set replaces the grid. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `BarList`, `Item`, `Tag`, `Link`, `DataTable`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `DropdownMenu`, `Skeleton`, `EmptyState` and `Button`. The ByActor variant pivots the same blocked and allowed data per actor: a FilterMenu of actor, outcome and category with a destination Input, seven outcome StatTiles, outcomes over time as stacked bars in status colors, breakdowns by actor, category and destination, and a request log DataTable naming the rule that decided each request. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: every tile, chart and the table hold a Skeleton, and Needs attention shows three placeholder rows.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No security rules set up yet: the tiles read as dashes, and one bordered EmptyState names the reason and offers Add rule set instead of a grid of empty charts.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.

variants.name: ByActor
variants.summary: Request activity per actor: a Time range Select and a Refresh IconButton in the header over a FilterMenu (actor, outcome, category) with its chips and a destination Input; seven outcome StatTiles (requests, allowed, blocked, held, approved, denied, over budget), outcomes over time as stacked bars in status colors, three BarList breakdowns (actor, category, destination) and a request log DataTable with an outcome Tag, a SeverityTag and the rule that decided each request. A filter that matches nothing shows Clear filters.
